account: second meshy account (api key 'devin-mcp', created via developer console)

petra.prompt: a cook vigorously scrubs a hot grill grate with a wire brush in both hands, then leans forward to inspect a piece of meat closely

dimitri.prompt: a chef dips a ladle into a simmering pot, raises it to his lips, blows on it gently and tastes it thoughtfully

anwar.prompt: a cook taps small metal ramekins down onto a counter one after another, then rolls out dough with a rolling pin

walkout.prompt: dramatic kitchen walkout: cook rips off apron, throws it down and storms off
walkout.clip: walkout-clip.fbx -> Walkout in all three runtime GLBs; hip x/z pinned to frame 0 (clip root travel cut — the scripted exit slide does the travel); played as LoopOnce for ~2.3s at the station, then the Running clip takes the wall-hugging exit

flinch.prompt: sudden full-body recoil/flinch, hands coming up defensively, then settling
flinch.clip: flinch-clip.fbx -> Flinch in all three runtime GLBs; hip x/z scaled 0.35 (a small back-step kept, the wall stays close); fires as LoopOnce on a new spikes.strainAt stamp while the cook idles, the idle loop steps underneath and resumes mid-window

pipeline: retarget-motion.mjs: SMPLH->mixamorig world-rotation-delta transfer (both rigs share a T-pose bind; verified in rest-audit.mjs), 30fps bake, hips position scaled by standing-hip ratio and delta-referenced to clip frame 0 (FBX bind pelvis offset is broken)
bake-prep-clip.mjs: writes the retargeted AnimationClip into the runtime GLB as an appended animation
idleLoops.ts: each cook's prep clip is a third idle variant (source <Name>Prep), seam-closed by wrapBlend like every window
BrigadeCook/PetraCook: Walkout + Flinch are LoopOnce actions; walkout holds the slide 2.3s for the apron rip, flinch triggers on cook.spikes.strainAt during idle
seam_probe: 9/9 windows loop without a pop; Prep seams are 0.8-0.9% of max in-loop step
